title: DOWNLOAD PYRI
subtitleSlim: Native desktop app — connect a local model for private, fully offline AI
autoUpdateHeadline: Install once — the desktop app keeps itself current.
autoUpdateBody: On every launch it checks for a newer release and updates silently in the background when online. The Android APK is sideloaded — grab the newest build here whenever you want to update.
osWinSlimNote: Windows 10/11 — slim installer or portable ZIP; use Ollama or LM Studio for offline AI
installGuideIntro: Choose your platform for installation notes and the requirements for a smooth first launch.
installMac: Open ENGRAM from Finder. If Gatekeeper warns that the developer cannot be verified, right-click the app, choose Open, and confirm. Signing and notarization are opt-in, so unsigned or unnotarized builds may show this warning.
requirementsMac: A Mac with Apple Silicon or Intel; internet is needed for online AI, while offline mode also needs space for a local model.
installWin: Run the .exe installer or extract the portable ZIP. If SmartScreen appears for an unsigned build, choose More info, then Run anyway. Code signing is opt-in and may not be present on every build.
requirementsWin: 64-bit Windows 10 or 11; internet is needed for online AI, while offline mode also needs space for a local model.
installLinux: For an AppImage, mark it executable with chmod +x and launch it. You can also install the .deb on Debian or Ubuntu. If the AppImage reports a FUSE error, install your distribution's FUSE compatibility package or use the .deb.
requirementsLinux: A 64-bit Linux distribution with the desktop GTK, NSS, notification, X11, OpenSSL, and OpenMP runtime libraries; the .deb declares Debian/Ubuntu dependencies.
installAndroid: Enable installs from your browser or file manager, open the APK, and approve the prompts. Android APKs are sideloaded; release signing is not guaranteed for every build.
requirementsAndroid: Android 8 or newer, plus permission to install apps from the browser or file manager that opened the APK.
errorReach: Couldn't reach the download service right now. You can browse all installers directly on the GitHub Releases page.
noInstallers: No installers are published yet. Installers (.dmg/.exe/.AppImage/.deb/.apk) have to be built on their target OS — this app can't build them itself. Once a build is committed to the deploy's <0>downloads/</0> folder or attached to a GitHub Release, it appears here automatically and stays up to date.
servedNote: Every installer is served directly by this app — bundled if present, otherwise proxied from the latest release.
